doc: Hush's 3D clip map (owner r3d-anim; index §7.10): the s2-view §4.1.1 schema over view/world/default_maps/hush.json (every key left out falls back to it; this file wins key by key). Clip ids = the 2D ids; sidecars data/anim/hush3d/<clip>.json. walk / run carry the 3D gait (stride_m, speed_m_s = the clip's sidecar values; RigPlayer3D scales playback to the actor's speed) and the 2D stride_px / speed_px_s the ClipMap uses (1 m = 200 px). rig:<prank> rows are derived by ClipMap / SliceClips.build3d from rig_actions.json (bands.<band>.clip = hush/rig_high|rig_mid|rig_low) — rigging@q/s/b resolve through them (act_tinker_* are not made in 3D). Rows of r3d-anim-hush-b are added from its DONE lines. curtain:bow is a clip_rules.json row with the same id.
